For Petitioner : Mr.K.Srinivasa Murthy  For Respondents : Mr.E.Sundaram,
 Govt. Advocate.
 ORDER

When the matter is taken up for consideration, it is brought to the notice of this Court by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner filed yet another writ petition, after filing of the present writ petition, vide W.P.No.18785 of 2019, and the said writ petition was allowed by a coordinate bench of this Court, vide order, dated 08.01.2025.
2.
In the light of the above order, according to the learned counsel for the petitioner, nothing survives in the present writ petition.
3. Accordingly, this Writ Petition is closed, for having become infructuous.
No costs.

Consequently,
the connected M.P.Nos.1,2, 3 and 4 of 2013 are closed.
